items.title: EU AI Act enforcement: agent transparency becomes an engineering requirement
items.rationale: The Commission's primary announcement confirms that enforcement and new transparency requirements began on 2026-08-02; the implementation guidance names concrete disclosure and machine-readable marking obligations. This is a durable governance-to-runtime-controls angle and a refresh/follow-up to existing governance and agent-security coverage, not a duplicate launch summary. Legal scope and product-specific applicability remain items for human review.

history.note: Verified the European Commission's 2026-07-31 announcement and the AI Act Service Desk agent FAQ during the 7-day backfill; flagged a governance/security refresh angle effective 2026-08-02.

items.title: Amazon Bedrock Agents Classic: maintenance mode and AgentCore migration
items.rationale: AWS documentation states that Bedrock Agents is now Agents Classic, entered maintenance mode, stopped accepting new customers on 2026-07-30, and recommends AgentCore as the migration path. The page includes a capability matrix, account allowlist behavior, model-freeze implications, and migration procedure. This is a durable platform migration and governance refresh for existing AgentCore and Enterprise RAG coverage; account-specific migration scope and cost still require human verification.

history.note: Seven-day backfill found the AWS maintenance-mode guide and verified the 2026-07-30 effective date, AgentCore recommendation, unchanged Knowledge Bases/Guardrails, and documented capability gaps.
